about: Site markets and their compositions, resolved against the federal roster (Census geoinfo 2025, OMB Bulletin 23-01). County is the atomic unit. A cbsa market takes the federal membership of its CBSA; a judgement composition carries review = true, its basis and, where it touches CBSAs, its difference from their federal membership. State ids are USPS codes in lower case (with their Census FIPS); counties are co-<FIPS>; CBSAs are cbsa-<code>; market ids are <state-slug>/<market-slug>. Assembled by docs/web-fsc-5/tools/assemble_geographies.py and resolve_geographies.py.
